title: START options beyond INTERVAL / TIME: the data options RTRANSID / RTERMID / QUEUE and RETRIEVE's ENVDEFERR, RETRIEVE with no INTO, AFTER / AT, INVREQ's RESP2, a REQID reused with FROM (IOERR); RUN TRANSID's child task

scenarios.summary: START FROM with RTRANSID, RTERMID and QUEUE: GT22's one RETRIEVE gets the data and all three values
START with FROM only: GT22's RETRIEVE also names RTRANSID / RTERMID / QUEUE, so ENVDEFERR
START with RTRANSID and no FROM: still a data record; GT23 RETRIEVEs it with no INTO, then ENDDATA
AFTER MINUTES(1), AFTER 0 h 0 m 30 s, AT 10:45 and TIME(250000) at 10:00: tasks at 10:00:30, 10:01, 10:45; the last is tomorrow's
INTERVAL(70), AFTER HOURS(1) MINUTES(60), AFTER SECONDS(360000), AFTER HOURS(100): INVREQ with RESP2 6, 5, 6, 4; nothing starts
RUN TRANSID('GT24') CHILD attaches a child task that runs (no terminal); RUN of an undefined transaction is TRANSIDERR RESP2 1
the same REQID twice, both with FROM: the second START is IOERR; only the first runs
